summary: Compared the retained customer-details source, reference, rendered crop and diff. The section bounds pass geometry (x +2 px, y +1.15625 px, exact width/height) and the crop ratio is 5.8308%, but several visible controls diverge from the source.
issues: VIS-CHECKOUT-CUSTOMER-001 | high | checkout field geometry | Expected two 400 x 43 px controls per row with consistent rounded borders and 15 px left-aligned placeholder text; actual first-name and surname controls are approximately half-width, while multiple inputs are shorter and use centered text/darker borders. Fix the native WooCommerce field wrappers and input/select sizing, radius, border color and text alignment to the sourced grid.

VIS-CHECKOUT-CUSTOMER-002 | high | alternate-shipping checkbox | Expected a visible 25 x 25 px outlined checkbox followed by the label; actual crop shows only a thin vertical mark with no checkbox box. Restore the visible native checkbox control and sourced spacing without replacing its behavior.

VIS-CHECKOUT-CUSTOMER-003 | medium | vertical spacing | Expected larger row gaps and the required-fields/checkbox block near the source y positions; actual fields and bottom labels are pulled upward, leaving excessive empty space below. Match the sourced row and footer-control spacing while retaining the passing outer bounds.
